courses.note: The major requires one of CS 375, 376 or 378; CS 375 taken as the first listed. The home page has a collaboration and academic integrity policy but no mention of AI; Schedule and Assignments subpages were not fetched.
The CS major lists no required software engineering or capstone/senior design course; electives include a two-semester sequence ending in a 400-level course, but no capstone is required.

courses.note: The major has an AI core requirement satisfied by a neural networks, simulation, human interpretable AI or interactive systems sequence (CS 343 listed first among those), so the course is effectively required as a choice among alternatives. CS 343 was offered in Fall 2024, Fall 2025, Spring 2026 and Fall 2026, the most often of the AI-core courses.

courses.note: Required. The Colby CS major requires no operating systems, networks or security course and the course listings for Fall 2024 to Fall 2026 show none offered, so the required systems course CS 232 is used; C3 is CS 375, so CS 232 is not already C3. Only the course landing page and lab links were available; no separate policies page was found and the saved text has no AI mention.

notes: The official Colby catalogue pages (colby.edu/catalogue) return a Cloudflare 403 to automated fetches, so degree requirements were taken from the Department of Computer Science curriculum page, which lists the same core. Department course sites on cs.colby.edu are public and index by term.
